name: Gáborjánháza (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gáborjánháza (a red and green shield with a white church and a griffin within a red and white lozengy border) below the name GÁBORJÁNHÁZA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
